subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, consent, subscription, and data-visibility contract should it expose?
rationale: Source review proves the capability is missing, but receiving non-mentioned Space content changes Google Chat credential storage, OAuth scopes, token refresh, event-subscription lifecycle, and operator consent boundaries.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub design with explicit scopes, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhooks Only
options.body: Leave the official Google Chat plugin on the current service-account webhook model and only handle the separate thread/session cleanup.

options.title: Defer To Shared Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a broader Google Workspace token, consent, event-subscription, and admin-approval model before implementing all-message ingestion.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub design with explicit scopes, setup docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across landed Google Chat thread support, the original channel merge, and the relevant product/security boundary.
